name: strong_cp_theta_bar
app_psc_label: Strong CP / θ̄ (open; candidate matching-rule sketch only)
formula: θ̄ ≡ 0 (mod 2π) → θ̄_physical = 0 from chirality-preserving icosahedral cycle closure
tier: Open problem (Tier 3 candidate mechanism only; no derivation)
app_psc_precision_str: Strong CP open in GCT (V3 Ch18 §18.5); θ̄ = 0 is a Tier 3 candidate sketch, not a prediction; nEDM bound |θ̄| < 10⁻¹⁰; OPEN_CONDITIONAL

extra.upper_bound_rule: OPEN_CONDITIONAL iff |theta_bar| < bound while QLQCD-1L remains open; equality or excess is FAIL
extra.mechanism: On the AKN icosahedral lattice, all chirality-preserving cycles (5-fold, 3-fold, 2-fold rotations of I_h) close at multiples of 2π exactly. The cut-and-project from Z⁶ preserves this discrete closure, forcing the topological charge of any consistent gauge configuration to integer multiples of 2π. The sketch then places θ̄ in the trivial topological class (θ̄ = 0). Integer topological charge makes θ 2π-periodic but does not by itself select θ̄ = 0; Tier 3 candidate sketch only, not a prediction.
extra.tier_1_promotion_path: QLQCD-1L closure (Open Problem O.5). Requires showing (a) anomaly-free topological quantisation under phason quantum corrections; (b) cut-and-project preserves discrete closure exactly (not up to O(α) corrections). Both are non-perturbative statements bundled with the QLQCD-1L research programme.
extra.falsifier: Next-gen nEDM measurements (SNS, n2EDM) reaching |d_n| < 10⁻²⁸ e·cm → |θ̄| < 10⁻¹² without detection would not support GCT, since θ̄ = 0 is not a GCT prediction. A robust non-zero θ̄ (an nEDM detection at >3σ) would rule out the candidate sketch.
